appeal_text: I am devastated by this grade. I lost 3 marks for using recursion in reverse_words, but I am sure the course staff changed that rule afterwards. It is so unfair to be penalised for following the rules, please fix it.

planted_error.description: 3 marks deducted for using recursion, which the announcement dated 2026-09-12 explicitly allows for reverse_words.
